text: Stefan and Nina are having a housewarming on Saturday from about four. Their new place is in Leith, just off the Shore, and it sounds like they've finally got the garden they wanted. Nina said not to bring anything, but Stefan quietly mentioned they still don't own a proper corkscrew or a decent set of mugs.
Kenji's driving test is next Tuesday. Third attempt, and he's really nervous about the roundabouts this time. Text him good luck on Monday night.
Zofia got engaged! Her boyfriend Pedro proposed in Lisbon last weekend. I need to send her a card before the end of the month.
Rachel mentioned her parents' 40th anniversary is sometime in early March. She's thinking of booking a dinner for the whole family.
Dinner at Aiko's on Friday cancelled, her flat's had a leak. She's staying with her sister Lin for a few days.
Jaya has her grade 8 piano exam tomorrow morning. Ask her how it went.
Eilidh is vegetarian and doesn't drink. Worth remembering for the barbecue.
Pick up the dry cleaning before Thursday and book the car in for its MOT sometime next week.

Aditi and Malik are celebrating ten years married over the summer. They're thinking about renting a villa in Sicily for a week and want a few of us to come. Aditi said dates are probably late June or early July, depending on when Malik's work quietens down. I should check my annual leave and let them know by the end of the month.
Kwame failed his theory test again yesterday. He seemed pretty fed up about it. I should check in with him this weekend.

Chen's daughter has her A level results on Thursday. Chen said she's barely sleeping and keeps refreshing the UCAS page even though nothing will change until the morning. She needs an A in chemistry for Glasgow. Chen and his wife are taking the day off to be with her, whatever happens.
Kofi's leaving drinks are next Friday at the Crown. He starts at the new firm in a fortnight.
Freya Murphy, Fifi to everyone at work, is auditioning for the Royal Conservatoire at the end of the month. She's been practising every evening.
Eduardo said Rohan and his wife are expecting their second in early spring. Don't forget to congratulate Rohan when I see him Tuesday.
Jack's 30th is on the 14th. He keeps going on about wanting a decent record player, so that could be the present.
Lola passed her driving test! First time, too. Her mum is apparently more relieved than she is.

Jen invited me to her engagement party next Saturday. It's at her parents' house in Stockbridge, garden if the weather holds. I'm bringing dessert, probably the lemon tart. Her fiancé Mehmet is apparently doing a speech, which should be entertaining given how shy he is. Her brother Alfie is flying back from Berlin for it.

Jasmine has a dog called Biscuit who is terrified of fireworks. She's dreading bonfire night and the whole week either side of it. Last year he hid under the bed for two days and wouldn't eat. She's going to try one of those calming jackets this time and stay in with him on the fifth rather than come to the party.
Alfie is retaking his maths GCSE in November. His dad says he's struggling with the algebra.
Kieran and Grace's wedding is on the 2nd of August. Save the dates went out today. Need to book a hotel near the venue soon.
Jamal's moot court competition is sometime next week. Remember to message him the night before.
Had dinner with Mehmet and Tendai. Mehmet is training to be a pilot and has his first big exam in early December. Tendai works as a midwife at the Royal Infirmary.

Rana's sister Sana is getting married in Karachi over Christmas. Rana flies out on the 18th and will be gone three weeks, with the mehndi, the nikah and the reception all on different days. She's a bit overwhelmed with outfits and gifts for everyone. Remind me to ask her for photos when she's back in January.
Pedro mentioned his grandmother's 90th birthday party is this weekend. The whole family is coming over from Porto.
Quiet day. Finally sorted the spare room ready for Mum visiting at the end of the month.
Stefan was saying his brother Kenji just got into the Edinburgh Jazz Orchestra after his audition last Friday. Stefan's really proud of him.
Nina's birthday dinner moved from Thursday to Saturday. Still at the Thai place on Dalry Road.
Zofia hates surprise parties. Do not let Pedro plan one for her.
Rachel's son is doing his driving test tomorrow afternoon. I said I'd text her later to see how it went.
Aiko is a structural engineer at Arup and lives in Morningside with her partner and their cat Mochi.

Jaya has her bar exams in early February. She's very anxious and mentioned she's been having trouble sleeping. Must remember to check on her after Christmas, and maybe take her out for a coffee in January.
Eilidh's anniversary is next Wednesday. She asked me to cover her shift so she and her husband can go away for a couple of nights.
Must buy a present for Lin's housewarming on Sunday. She mentioned she needs decent wine glasses.
Malik's surprise 40th is on Saturday the 9th. Aditi is organising it and swore everyone to secrecy. I'm doing the playlist.
Kwame's sister Sana graduates from Leeds in early July. The whole family is going down for the ceremony and a meal afterwards.

Chen called. The wedding is off. He and his fiancée broke up last month and he's moved back in with his parents. He sounded rough. I should call him again next week, maybe invite him round for dinner.
Kofi passed his citizenship test yesterday. Send him congratulations.
Freya's recital is on Thursday at seven. Her mum and Uncle Pedro are coming too.

Eduardo has a job interview at the bank on Monday. He wants to practise with me tomorrow evening, so I said I'd go round after work. He's been out of work since the summer and money's getting tight, so this one really matters to him. Remember to ask him on Monday night how it went.
Book a table for six on Friday for Rohan's promotion drinks.
Jack Hughes is allergic to nuts. Remember for Saturday's dinner party.
Lola and her girlfriend Sana have been together five years in a fortnight. Lola wants ideas for something special, maybe a weekend in the Lakes.
Jen's cello audition for the orchestra was on Monday. Haven't heard how it went yet. Ask her when I see her at book club on Wednesday.
Jasmine's nephew starts his university entrance exams next week. She says the whole house is on edge.
Alfie's grandad passed away last week. The funeral is sometime next week, date to be confirmed. He's taking it hard.

Lunch with Kieran today. He's thinking about proposing to Grace over the summer, maybe on holiday in Greece. He wants me to help choose a ring sometime in the next few weeks. He's nervous she'll say it's too soon, but honestly they've been together six years and her parents already love him. Need to keep this to myself at the Halloween party on Friday.
Jamal mentioned that his parents are celebrating their 35th anniversary at the end of the month. He's planning a dinner for them at their favourite Italian.
Mehmet's partner Rana has her final practical nursing exam in a fortnight. Mehmet says she's barely coping with the stress.
Tendai's brother Jamal is having his engagement party next weekend in Manchester. Tendai is driving down Friday night.
Got invited to Grace's book launch party on Thursday evening. Wear something smart.
Stefan Fischer and his wife Zofia renewed their vows last weekend. Lovely photos on the group chat. I should send them a little gift.

Nina has her PhD viva on Tuesday morning. She's terrified, keeps saying the external examiner is notoriously tough. Text her good luck the night before, and then on Wednesday, once it's done, take her out for a drink to celebrate or commiserate.
Rachel and her husband Kofi have their 20th wedding anniversary on Sunday. They're doing a small dinner for close friends on Saturday and I'm invited. Don't forget to pick up flowers on the way.

Took Kenji for coffee. He's started learning Polish because his fiancée's family barely speaks English, and he's determined to give a toast in Polish at the wedding next spring. He's still a huge fan of jazz and goes climbing at the wall in Ratho most weekends. Said he'd lend me his copy of Kind of Blue.
Aiko's results day for her architecture exams is early next month. She's quietly confident.
Need to RSVP to Eduardo's dinner party by Wednesday. It's on the Saturday after next.
Called Mum. Dad's birthday is on Sunday, and she wants us all there for lunch. I'm bringing a cake. Also need to sort out the train tickets this week.

Lin's daughter Grace has her ballet exam on Saturday morning, then they're going to Lin's in-laws for a family dinner on Sunday. Lin says Grace has been practising nonstop and is pretty nervous. I said I'd drop round a good luck card on Friday after work, and Lin wants me to come along to the dinner if I'm free.
Freya's housewarming was on Saturday but I couldn't make it. Ask her how it went and whether she's settled in.
Rohan says Jasmine got her test results back and everything is clear. Big relief all round.
